title: O God of Light and Glory
description: O God of Light and Glory in Tonic Solfa to ST. ALPHEGE, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Greek Office Books (Paisley, 1904).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Sevens and Sixes (7.6.7.6), and this page sets them to ST. ALPHEGE; any other Sevens and Sixes tune fits them as well.
underlay: O God of light and glo-ry, Thy ser-vants look to see The light that shines ef-ful-gent Up-on their souls from Thee.

lines: O God of light and glory,
And lo! the heavens are open,
And from the throne of God,
For only they who see Thee

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Greek Office Books (1904)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Greek Office Books; set to ST. ALPHEGE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
